title: kith-jmap: error_status maps notFound to 404 but method-level notFound must stay HTTP 200
description: error_status() maps 'notFound' to StatusCode::NOT_FOUND (404) and 'accountNotFound' to StatusCode::NOT_FOUND. However error_status() is only called from request_error(), which is used for request-level (pre-dispatch) failures, not method-level errors. Method-level errors go through error_invocation() which places them inside methodResponses at HTTP 200 per RFC 8620 §3.4. So the notFound mapping in error_status() would only be triggered if a caller explicitly uses request_error(JmapError::not_found()) for a pre-dispatch error. RFC 8620 §7.1 says notFound is a method-level error, not a request-level error. Using it as a request-level error (which would return HTTP 404) is incorrect per the RFC. The error_status() match arm for notFound should either be removed (it has no valid caller) or the function should be documented to only accept request-level error types.
